title: Canonical pro-etale supported exterior product and finite-coefficient presentation
statement:
Use the small pro-etale sites and constant coefficient modules of
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], their derived categories and derived tensor
[def-weil-derived-tensor], and the closed support functors of
[def-pur-support-cohomology]. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $B,X,Y,Z,W$
be schemes, and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$, $j:W\hookrightarrow Y$ be closed
immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Suppose $X,Y$ are locally Noetherian and
$f:X\to B$, $g:Y\to B$ have locally Noetherian fibre product
$P=X\times_B Y$ [def-pc-base-change]. Write $p:P\to X$, $q:P\to Y$ for its
projections and $h=i\times_B j:Z\times_B W\to P$.

For an $A$-module $M$, define $C_i(M)=i_*\underline M_Z$ and the quotient
$q_i:\underline M_X\to C_i(M)$ by the constant-sheaf inverse-image identification
and the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction. This exact functor is left adjoint
to $\Gamma_Z$. Fix this adjunction uniquely by requiring, for every sheaf $F$ and
map $a:M\to\Gamma_Z(F)$, that its adjoint precomposed with $q_i$ equals the
constant-sheaf adjoint of $a$ followed by the kernel inclusion
$\Gamma_Z(F)\to\Gamma(X,F)$. Derive this exact-left/right-derived adjunction to
obtain $C_i:D(A)\to D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ left adjoint to $R\Gamma_Z$, and
likewise for $j,h$.

For $A$-modules $M,N$, fix
$\theta:C_h(M\otimes_A N)\to p^*C_i(M)\otimes_A q^*C_j(N)$ uniquely by its
composite with $q_h$: the constant-section tensor pairing followed by
$p^*q_i\otimes_A q^*q_j$. On signed total complexes fix the chain map by this
map on every $(r,s)$ summand with $r+s=n$. Localize using K-flat complexes; fix
the derived comparison uniquely by naturality in both variables and compatibility
with the tensor-localization comparison on every pair of cochain representatives.
For $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ and $L\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ define
$$
\kappa^{Z,W}_{K,L}:R\Gamma_ZK\otimes_A^L R\Gamma_WL
\longrightarrow R\Gamma_h(K\boxtimes_A^L L)
$$
as the adjoint of the derived $\theta$ followed by the tensor of the pulled-back
evaluation counits. This is the pro-etale analogue of
[def-pur-supported-exterior-product].

The canonical finite-coefficient realization from fixed $A$-module sheaves to
modules over the associated constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]
is an exact equivalence. Its derived inverse supplies the fixed-ring presentation
of each specified etale-origin realization [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness].
For schemes locally of finite type over a field [def-weil-finite-type-morphism],
use the same $\kappa$, deriving the locally Noetherian instances from the structure
maps.
